def solution():
    number = "4532015112830365"
    total = 0
    parity = len(number) % 2

    for i, digit in enumerate(number):
        value = int(digit)
        if i % 2 == parity:
            value *= 2
            if value > 9:
                value -= 9
        total += value

    return total % 10 == 0
